canonical_facts_binding.evidence: The canonicalized current facts digest equals the independently embedded pin. Adding fictitious HCA employer data while leaving résumé bytes/hash unchanged now returns employer_baseline_hash_mismatch.

destination_and_resume_reference.evidence: The prior combined attack now returns missing_exact_job_url and row_0:unverified_resume_reference_requires_semantic_review. HTTPS parsing requires a hostname, dotted host, non-root path, and excludes credentials/fragments; arbitrary resume:* references are rejected unless indexed.

policy_scope.evidence: The canonical SKILL describes non-employment fields outside the indexed baseline as requiring baseline extension/review or remaining blocked. It states user-confirmed/application-record references are procedural and need separate existence/truth review; checker output retains semantic_review_required=true and submission_authorized=false.

limitations: The checker intentionally does not classify natural-language questions, verify user-confirmed/application-record truth, authorize submission, or enforce atomic cross-session deduplication. The workflow requires separate form/claim review, scoped authorization, and receipt/tracker checks.
The 16 tests and probes are synthetic/local; no real ATS portal, browser flow, upload, form, CAPTCHA, account, confirmation receipt, or application submission was exercised.
A legitimate résumé replacement or fact-baseline extension requires explicit review and a new trusted facts pin before the checker can pass.
Different-model-family GEV separation was not established.

resolved_findings.proof: Exact facts-mutation probe changed from zero errors to employer_baseline_hash_mismatch.
Exact malformed URL/arbitrary résumé-source probe changed from zero errors to two blocking errors.

scope: Canonical capability only. Read-only code, documentation, regression suite, and exact adversarial-probe rerun; no staging review, browser, portal, provider, or submission calls.
